move: badge springs up, four logo facets fly in and lock, text rises, badge tilts in 3D
how: A black Google Play style badge with a four-facet triangle logo, two masked text lines and a blurred floor shadow. Over the first 23% of the 3s loop the badge scales 0.6 to 1 from y 40 with back.out(1.6) and the shadow grows in; the four coloured facets fly in from left, top, bottom and right (offset 60px, opacity 0) with back.out(1.8) at 0.25, 0.33, 0.41 and 0.49s and lock together; 'Get it on' and 'Play Store' rise from yPercent 120 with expo.out. At 1.05s a skewed gloss strip sweeps across. From 1.5s the badge tilts rotationY 14 / rotationX -6 with a 900px perspective and returns with power2.inOut while the logo spins a full 360 with power3.inOut. At 2.6s (87%) the badge shrinks to 0.6, rises 40px and fades with power3.in so the frame empties.
adapt: Swap the facet paths and colours for another logo, change the two text lines and the badge colours; the four fly-in directions map to facet positions. Keep the 0.08s facet cadence and the 3D tilt at half the duration.
port: mount(el, shot) builds shadow and badge (logo svg with four facet paths, two masked lines, shine) inside el. animate returns the timeline with entry 0 to 0.233D, facets 0.083D to 0.163D, text 0.15D / 0.183D, gloss 0.35D, tilt 0.5D to 0.883D, exit 0.867D. The from() tweens on facets and text need immediateRender:false; facet transforms rely on transform-box: fill-box.
caveats: facet transforms depend on transform-box: fill-box CSS
transformPerspective set on the badge for the tilt
